Pick an entry: its details show here, and choosing it acts at once.
Ready to play.\nThe game files are in %1$s.
The game files are not installed yet.\n\nThis app contains no game data. You supply your own copy: a disc image of the game you own, or a folder with its files in it.
The runtime could not be loaded:\n%1$s

Point this at a disc image (.iso) of your own copy, or at a folder holding the files from one. Everything needed is copied into the app\'s own storage and checked as it goes; about 7 GB of free space is wanted.
Cancelled. What was copied is kept, so starting again carries on from there.
The install is still running. Leaving now stops it; it can be carried on later.
There is not enough free space: %1$s free, about 7 GB needed.

The Files app hands over a document rather than a path, so the file is copied into this app first: %1$s now, and about 7 GB again for the installed game. %2$s is free.\n\nIf space is tight, use “Browse the phone’s storage” instead — it reads the file where it lies.

The Files app hands over a document rather than a path, so the file is copied into this app first. A disc image is several gigabytes, and the installed game needs about 7 GB more.\n\nIf space is tight, use “Browse the phone’s storage” instead — it reads the file where it lies.
Android only lets an app read files outside its own folder once you allow it. Without that, put the disc image in Android/data/%1$s/files and pick it from there.

Adreno phones can run Mesa\'s Turnip driver, which is often much quicker than the one the phone shipped with, and sometimes renders things the shipped one gets wrong. Import the driver\'s zip archive as it was downloaded; it is unpacked into the app\'s own storage.
That archive does not look like a driver: it has no meta.json naming the library inside it.
That driver is not for this phone (arm64 is needed).
Vulkan %1$s, for Android API %2$d and later

How many pixels are actually drawn, as a share of the screen. The display scales the result up, which costs nothing. This is the single biggest thing a weaker phone can be given; 60 to 75 percent looks close to the original console.
Vulkan internal render scale (MW2_SCALE). Multiplies the title\'s base framebuffer dimensions: 1x native, 2x (supersampled), 3x (high-end). Higher multipliers require significant GPU horsepower.
85° is recommended for ultrawide 20:9 mobile displays. (65° was original 16:9 console FOV).
Texture memory: chosen for this phone
How much the texture cache may hold before it starts letting go of what has not been drawn for a while. Left alone, the runtime picks a figure from the memory this phone has.
Turn this off to ignore controllers entirely. Some phones report an accessory, or their own sensors, as a gamepad with a stick that is not centred, which makes the character walk on its own.
Evens out a finger\'s jitter on glass. Too much and aiming feels like it is on ice.
The on-screen pad is edited in the game: pause and choose “Edit controls”.
The files stay on the phone; the app simply stops using them, and the next install can point somewhere else.

Extra maps, weapons and modes for this install\'s game version. Choose the extracted folder: its .ff, .pak and .bik files are copied into the game folder. Scripts and plugins are reported and left alone — this port runs no plugin system.
Installed %1$d file(s) into the game folder.%2$s
That folder holds nothing to install: no .ff, .pak or .bik files.
Shader cache cleared. Shaders rebuild as you play.

A controller is attached, so a second player can join: Spec Ops co-op and split-screen multiplayer take a second player through the game\u2019s sign-in screen.\n\nHeads-up: two viewports cost frames. Expect dips below 60 FPS, a hot phone, and fast battery drain — lower the display resolution first on weaker devices.

Compiles every recorded pipeline before the title screen instead of warming them up during play. Boot takes minutes on a cold cache and the phone gets warm, but there is almost no in-game shader stutter left afterwards. Off means the quick 2-second boot with background warmup.
The name other players on the network see (15 characters at most). Empty means the profile\u2019s name, which on a fresh install is \u201cPlayer 1\u201d.
When another player on the network invites this phone to their lobby, join without asking. Off means invites are only logged.
Which connection sessions invite to: a name or address piece (WiFi, wlan0, 192.168.1). Needed with a VPN and WiFi at once, so guests are told a door they can reach.
Nobody heard on the network yet — host a lobby on the other machine first, on the same WiFi.
%1$s: %2$d file(s) changed. Restart the match to play on them.
This install is build %1$d, the release carries build %2$d.\n\nOpen the release page and install the APK over this one — no uninstall, no data loss.
The download failed. Open the release page instead.
The game ends now. Anything the game itself has not saved is lost.
The runtime library would not load:\n%1$s
The game files are not installed. Install them from the launcher first.
The runtime would not start. The log has the details.
Touch a control to pick it up. Drag to move it, pinch to resize.
%1$s — drag to move, pinch to resize
Hidden controls are shown faintly here so they can be turned back on.
Every control goes back where it started, at its original size.
